title: Benefits as an exhibitor
html:
• Main meeting point of the worldwide dental family
    IDS is the melting pot for the entire dental community - meet up with top decision-makers from the dental industry, dental technicians trade, specialised trade, education and politics sectors.
  • Qualified visitor structure
    Over 80% of the IDS visitors are involved in purchasing and procurement decisions, every third visitor is indeed decisively involved.
  • Personal exchange
    The international dental press meets up at IDS, arouse the attention of the top journalists from Germany and all over the world
  • Worldwide attention
    As such an excellent media echo is achieved worldwide prior to, during and after IDS

Meeting place for the industry

Here you'll meet all your direct contacts at one place. Exchange ideas with your industry peers on services, products and the latest developments.

Learn more about the trade fair

Central in every respect

The Cologne site is easy to reach for customers at home and abroad. Thanks to the fair site being located in the city center, there are many hotels in the immediate vicinity.

Learn more about the Cologne site

Free travel to IDS

For your hotel choice and arrival: Best train connections from the greater Düsseldorf, Bonn and Ruhr areas to Cologne - free of charge with your exhibitor pass.

Plenty of room for your ideas

On one of Europe's largest trade fair grounds you can plan any presentation and events of any kind - and with the Koelnmesse organisation, you have a dynamic associate to assist you.

Learn more about the exhibition grounds

Become an exhibitor

Apply as an exhibitor and find out about the costs and terms and conditions.

Apply and calculate the costs

No Copy! – Originals only!

Learn how you can protect your products and brands. Koelnmesse will assist you.
